rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously listed offerings
instrumental sense in context despite long ending
gerund of dhyai indicating prior mental contemplation
instrument of the subsequent ritual act

items.question: How are all offerings to be arranged after mental meditation?
premises: All offerings are first meditated upon by mind.
Flower casting is the means of arrangement.
items.inference: Mental contemplation precedes the physical arrangement of offerings by flower casting.
uncertainties: manasāṃ may be genitive plural rather than instrumental singular.
kalpayet may be imperative rather than optative.
items.plain_english: Having meditated on all of that by mind, one should arrange it by casting a flower.
